record.description_evidence:
WorkoutAI has AI-Powered workouts for effective muscle building and weight loss. Tailored for both home workouts and gym training, our app offers personalized fitness plans, focusing on strength training and bodyweight exercises. Our app uses FitAI artificial intelligence to create smart workout routines.

WorkoutAI is also an AI personal trainer for building muscle and losing weight at home. We have workouts for men and women to get a six-pack, build biceps, triceps, shoulder or any muscle. We also have cardio exercises for women and men to lose weight. You can lose weight at home with our no equipment bodyweight workouts. Our app uses FitAI artificial intelligence to prepare workout plans.

WorkoutAI has 3700+ exercises, including dumbbell and bodyweight home exercises. We have exercises for chest, biceps, abs, shoulder, quadriceps, triceps, glutes, hamstring, lats, forearms, traps, calves. Our most popular exercises are push-ups, pull-ups, squats, lunges, planks, burpees, sit-ups, crunches, leg raises. 

WorkoutAI can be your personal fitness coach which gives you a personal workout plan and daily workouts.  You can lose weight at home, build muscle at home, and do all workouts with no equipment at home. Our workout tracker and gym log helps you build muscle or lose weight faster. WorkoutAI assistant can respond your all fitness related questions with the help of chatgpt. 

WorkoutAI can be used as a workout planner for gym or fitness tracker for home. AI learns from your workout history to help you build muscle fast or lose weight quickly.  It recommends cardio and strength exercises for you. You can do HIIT exercises, aerobics and cardio exercises, bodyweight exercises, running/jogging, weight training, and cycling. WorkoutAI has muscle analysis which focus on arms and legs workout. It also has workout reports and top exercises for you.


Subscription information:

- To access pro features, you should have an active subscription. Subscription periods are 1 month, 6 months and 1 year. Subscription renews every month, 6 months or year respectively. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.

- You can cancel your subscription via this url: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039

- Privacy Policy: https://futuresoftcompany.com/workoutapp/privacypolicy

Unlock personalized healthy programs tailored just for you. Whether you're embarking on a fasting journey, seeking a balanced diet plan, or ready to embrace gentle carb cycling, Appediet provides comprehensive guidance and support.

Download Appediet now and embark on a transformative adventure towards a healthier, happier you. Revolutionize the way you approach nutrition, fitness, and weight management with our powerful features and user-friendly interface.

record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
“Stronger at 58 than I was at 27” -Bob M. If you're looking for a workout planner to build muscle and strength, we have something even better for you. This app gets you in shape fast using artificial intelligence. It's 59% faster, evidence-based, and always up to date.

Expert reviews:
"It makes working out very simple. All you do is answer a few questions about your unique situation and your goals, and then it generates a workout program for you..."
— Jason Maxwell - Aerospace Engineer and fitness and nutrition author

"90% of people over the age of 35 lose enough muscle every year to burn off an additional 4 pounds of body fat. Don't let this happen to you. Lift weights. You'll look and feel years younger..."
— John Rowley - Best-selling co-author of Old School New Body

"...When the weights get too heavy, it deloads your weights automatically for you. That way, in the long run, you can build more muscle and keep your joints healthy."
— Lee Hayward - Competitive bodybuilder, Muscle building coach, and Author

A PERSONAL INVITATION 
Hi, I'm Dr. Carl Juneau. In 2009, I got really sick and lost all my muscle mass. As a trainer, that was rough. Let's just say clients didn't really trust me, even with a PhD. I just didn't look the part. 

I finally gained back 27.7 lbs of muscle, but that was tough. I kept failing. Now, I'm squeezing all I learned into this app. It's an intelligent, virtual coach that takes the guesswork out of training and gets you in shape fast. With your smart coach, every time you complete a set, your program updates automatically to match your progress, and speed up future progress.

It gets you in shape fast, like a personal trainer. But it's 59% faster, evidence-based, and always up to date. It automates almost everything, and guides you through the entire process. It's designed to make training a rewarding experience, simple, and fun again.

DR. MUSCLE IS A PERSONAL TRAINER IN YOUR PHONE
‣ Customizes your workouts based on your profile and your own progress
‣ Gets you in shape 59% faster with rest-pause and other advanced techniques
‣ Uses artificial intelligence to update your program every time you work out
‣ Always up to date and evidence-based

FEATURES
- 34+ workouts
- 500+ exercises
- Gym workouts
- Home workouts
- Weight lifting or bodyweight

BUSY? GET A CUSTOM PROGRAM IN 5 MINUTES
Based on your age, goals, and experience.

ADVANCED? CUSTOMIZE EVERYTHING
- Add your own exercises and workouts
- Customize reps, sets, rest...

The AI will apply its logic to your custom program.

GAIN MUSCLE & STRENGTH FAST WITH ADVANCED, EVIDENCE-BASED METHODS, AUTOMATICALLY
- Deloads
- Rest-pause sets
- Daily undulating periodization (DUP)
- Reps in reserve (RIR-based RPE)
- And 18 more!

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
- Full workout history
- Charts for all exercises
- Charts for your average progression

APPLE HEALTH
Tracks automatically:
- Calories
- Workout time

MORE
- Chat (your human coach and fellow serious lifters await you inside)
- Backed up in the cloud (never lose your data)
- Track your fitness
- View your history online
- Upload a custom program

GREAT FOR:
- Powerlifting
- Bodybuilding
- Strength training
- Hypertrophy training

FREE TRIAL
No payment info needed. Download to start your trial. Includes all features.

SUBSCRIPTION INFO
Sign up to Dr. Muscle to continue building muscle faster after your free trial:
- $48.99 / month
- $399.99 / year

Price may vary by location. 

Once you confirm your subscription purchase, your payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited. Your iTunes account will be charged again when your subscription renews automatically at the end of the current subscription period, unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before. You can turn off auto-renew anytime in your iTunes account settings.

record.name: KiloAI: AI Fitness Trainer
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Build muscle, increase your strength, or get lean with KiloAI. Whether you are at home in the gym or outside, KiloAI’s training algorithm will provide you with a personalized workout designed to help you reach your fitness goals.

A new generation of AI fitness

Unlike existing fitness apps, KiloAI’s algorithm doesn’t just assemble random workouts. Our technology looks at your unique attributes (gender, weight, age, training level) and studies your workout patterns to evolve around your schedule, goals, equipment, and place of training.

As you train more, KiloAI gets better. Your training plan will maximize your progress by adjusting intensity, volume, and weight for each session. The outcome is a balanced, effective workout every time.

Optimal exercises

Not all exercises are created equal and KiloAI knows this. We believe that mastering the most effective exercises is more important than having different exercises every time. We balance optimal movements and variation so that your exercises are diverse and challenging.

For beginners, or seasoned gym-goers looking for new workouts, we have over 600 detailed trainer-led videos so you can always add new movements with confidence.

Track your progress

KiloAI’s Strength Score makes measuring your strength and progress straightforward. We calculate this based on 8 different subscores and millions of data points across people of your same age, gender, body weight, and fitness experience.

Customization

You can let KiloAI lead the way 100% or set up your own custom workout settings. You have the power to change your fitness goal, workout variety level, muscle split, duration, equipment, and more!

Why KiloAI?

KiloAI combines leading fitness research, input from certified personal trainers, and constant feedback from our community to deliver a solution that is effective, affordable, and practical.

*ALL FEATURES REQUIRE AN ACTIVE SUBSCRIPTION.

By using this app, you agree to Apple’s standard End User License Agreement (EULA). You can view the full EULA at: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

record.name: Stelvo · AI Fitness Coach
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Stelvo is the AI fitness coach that actually remembers you.

Most fitness apps are silent libraries — you log a workout, the app says "great job," and forgets you exist until the next session. Stelvo is the opposite. Scan your physique to see where you stand, then get a coach that learns what works for your body, your schedule, and your goals — and adjusts every session like it reads your training log every morning.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

• See where you're starting. Scan your physique in seconds for a body-composition read, then watch it change as you train — progress you can actually see, not just numbers on a bar.

• A coach with persistent memory. Tell it once that your left knee acts up on heavy squats, and it'll factor that into every plan, every set, every recommendation — forever. You can see exactly what it remembers, and delete anything you don't want.

• Plans that adapt to what actually happened. Skipped legs three weeks in a row? It rebalances. PR'd your bench by 5kg? It updates the next session's load. No more rigid 8-week programs that ignore reality.

• Talk to it while you train. Tap the chat bubble mid-workout: "swap incline DB press, bench is taken" or "should I push for one more rep?" — get a useful answer in two seconds.

• Track everything that matters. Workouts, sets, reps, weights, supersets, body measurements, personal records — all in a clean dark interface that doesn't try to be a social network you didn't ask for.

• Stats that tell you something. Volume trends per body part. Time-since-last-hit. PR cadence. Streak protection. Real numbers, not vanity dashboards.

• Voice input. Press and hold the mic, talk to your coach hands-free between sets. No typing while your forearms are pumped.

WHO IT'S FOR

Lifters and gym-goers who want an opinionated, personalized program — not a feature list. People who train 3+ days a week and care about progressive overload. Beginners welcome; advanced users get the depth.

WHO IT'S NOT FOR

If you want endless video libraries, scrollable social feeds, or step-counting — there are great apps for that. This one is laser-focused on the lift.

HONEST AI USE

The AI coach is a tool, not a doctor. It uses Anthropic's Claude models routed through OpenRouter; your training data is processed to generate recommendations and is never sold. See the in-app memory screen for full transparency on what's stored, and delete anything (or your whole account) with one tap.

SUBSCRIPTION

$9.99/month, or $59.99/year (save 50%). No free trial. Cancel anytime from your Apple ID settings — your data stays accessible during the cancellation period and is erased completely if you delete your account.

Built in Brooklyn by Mott House LLC.

Terms: https://stelvo.app/legal/terms

record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Most training apps hand you a program and never touch it again. Other workout apps with an AI will talk to you all day while the workout on screen doesn't move.

Aldo does the thing neither does: it changes the actual program, in front of you, because of something you said or something you logged.

COACHES EVERY SET
Your session is written before you walk in — the lifts, the loads, the reps. Log a set and Aldo answers underneath it: what that rep speed meant, and what it's doing about it. Not a chat you have to go and open. A line under the set you just finished. Hit a top set written at RPE 8 and finish it at 6, and the back-off sets below are already written back up, waiting on one tap: Use all or Keep all.

BUILDS YOUR PLAN
Tell Aldo your goal, your equipment, and how you train. It writes a full periodized program, week by week — not a template with your name on it. Setup is a short chat with Aldo, and you can skip any question. Then it plans around the weeks you actually have: sync your calendar and a work trip or a late shift becomes part of the plan instead of the reason you fell off it.

PROGRAM TAB
See your week on the Plan section. On the Progress section, Aldo makes a call on every main lift and muscle group after each workout. Disagree? Tap it and make it your call. 

ANY GOAL
Powerlifting, CrossFit, bodybuilding, or just staying in the game for another thirty years. Conditioning is first-class, not bolted onto a lifting app — an EMOM, an AMRAP, a circuit or a complex is written with real numbers, runs on its own timer, and gets scored when you're done.

YOU SET THE CEILING
Coming back from something? Give Aldo a pain score with each set and it tracks the trend across the load, not just the last reading. Quiet at 185, still quiet at 225, and the session keeps going. Cross the ceiling you set and Aldo flags it and proposes a lighter set, even when the lift itself felt easy. Proposed, not imposed. You tap Apply.

REMEMBERS EVERYTHING
Mention a sore shoulder once and Aldo files it: what aggravates it, what doesn't, and a ceiling on the lift that caused it until it's been quiet for a couple of sessions. It programs around it without being asked again. The same memory holds your working loads, your equipment, and the fact that you'd rather be out of the gym in an hour on a weekday. All of it is yours to read and edit.

YEARS OF HISTORY
Every lift has its own page — estimated 1RM over time, your best single, triple, five and eight, and every session you've ever done it. It's not just a chart to look at: it's the same history Aldo reads before it writes your next session. Already training? Upload a spreadsheet or a PDF of your log and Aldo will read it in.

WORKS OFFLINE
Your program, your history, and today's session live on your device and don't disappear without a signal. Sending a message to your coach needs a connection, like any AI feature does — the app itself doesn't.

YOUR DATA
Your training data is yours. It's used to run your coaching, never sold and never used for advertising.

WHAT ALDO IS NOT
Not a doctor, a physio, or a medical device. It doesn't diagnose or treat anything and it can't clear you to return from an injury. It's not a replacement for a coach who can watch you lift, and it isn't infallible — it's an AI model and it can be wrong. Read the Health & Safety Notice before you train with it.

Aldo is built and run by River Lentil LLC, a single-member California LLC with no staff — one person writes the code and answers the support mail. Questions, problems, or a deletion request: support@aldo-coach.app. We reply within 3 business days.

Your Fitness, Rewarded.
Deeply Intelligent. Truly Rewarding.

Plan workouts, log your training, and keep nutrition in one place with Workit. Build a gym or home routine around your goals, follow your program, and see your progress over time.

Create a personalized program around your goals, experience, equipment and training days. Preview upcoming exercises, follow demonstrations, and swap exercises when your routine needs a change.

Your workout card highlights the muscles in the day's planned exercises. Open your program from the card, start your workout, or return to the active Workout Player. Rest days include an easy-walking suggestion.

ACTIVITY AND APPLE HEALTH
Connect Apple Health to see available steps, active energy, sleep and heart-rate readings alongside your training. Explore 7-day and 30-day views of your recorded activity. Health features depend on available data and permissions; heart-rate measurements require a compatible source.

IPHONE AND APPLE WATCH
Log workouts on iPhone or follow them from your wrist with the Workit Apple Watch app. Keep completed workouts and your training journal connected.

Explore fitness challenges and rewards for eligible activity. Availability, eligibility and reward terms are shown in the app.

record.description_evidence:
Your personal trainer, in your pocket.

Worka replaces every fitness app on your phone with one that does it all — and gets you to your goals, week after week.

A personal trainer costs hundreds a month. Worka gives you the same thing for a fraction: a plan built for you that adapts to your body and your progress.

AI COACH THAT BUILDS YOUR PLAN
Tell the AI coach your goals and get a phased training plan — base, build, peak, and taper. It adapts every week based on your runs, lifts, circuits, and recovery data. Like having a trainer who adjusts your plan every day.

GPS RUN TRACKING
Real-time pace, distance, and splits with a voice coach that keeps you on target without looking at your phone.

WEIGHT LOGGING
Real progressive overload. Log sets, reps, weight, and RPE, and build strength systematically.

GUIDED CIRCUITS
Timed exercises with video demos. Warm-up, work, cool-down — just hit play and follow along.

RECOVERY MONITORING
Connects with Apple Watch, Apple Health, Health Connect, and BLE sensors to track HRV, sleep quality, strain, and VO2 max. It knows when to push you and when to rest — so you train smart, not just hard.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLATFORM
Most apps only see part of your training. Worka sees all of it — and uses it to move you closer to your goal every week.

Everything included:
• Phased AI training plans
• Daily workout suggestions
• GPS runs with a voice coach
• Weight logging with progressive overload
• Timed circuits with video demos
• Recovery monitoring (HRV, sleep, strain, VO2 max)
• Import your workouts from Apple Health (Garmin, Strava, and more)

• Works with Apple Watch, Health Connect, and Bluetooth sensors

record.description_evidence:
TRAIN SMARTER WITH YOUR AI WORKOUT PARTNER
Tired of navigating clunky menus mid-workout? Gym Spark makes tracking faster with voice. Tap "Record", then tell Spark what you're doing: "bodyweight squats, 3 sets of 15" or "just finished bench press, 185 for 8 reps." Add exercises, log completed sets, or modify your workout—all without fumbling through forms and dropdowns. Spark is your AI coaching companion that learns your training style, tracks your progress, and keeps you motivated. Whether you're building your first routine or chasing new PRs, Spark adapts to you.

VOICE-POWERED TRACKING
- Say what you did—Spark logs it automatically
- Add exercises mid-workout 
- Modify routines on the fly with simple voice commands
- Ask questions: "What's a good substitute for bench press?”

GOAL TRACKING THAT ACTUALLY MOTIVATES 
Set strength goals, body composition targets, or workout frequency commitments. Spark tracks your progress and celebrates wins. Watch your personal records fall as you get stronger—Spark remembers every PR.

500+ EXERCISES AT YOUR FINGERTIPS 
From barbell basics to cable machines, our extensive database covers every exercise. Each includes proper form guidance, targeted muscles, and equipment needed. Can't find something? Add custom exercises in seconds.

SMART WORKOUT ORGANIZATION
Save favorite routines for quick access
Filter by body part (Chest, Back, Legs, Arms, and more)
AI-generated workout suggestions based on your history
Quick-start any workout with one tap

TRACK EVERY WORKOUT TYPE
Strength: sets, reps, weight
Cardio: duration, distance, pace
Time-based: planks, stretches, holds
Mixed workouts combining everything

APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION 
Seamlessly sync with Apple Health. Import workouts from your Apple Watch or export Gym Spark data to Health—everything in one place.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFTERS
- Rest timer between sets
- Detailed workout history and summaries
- Progress analytics and performance trends

GET PERSONALIZED AI INSIGHTS 
Spark analyzes your training patterns and offers tailored suggestions. Overtraining chest? Spark notices. Haven't hit legs this week? You'll get a friendly reminder. It's like having a knowledgeable training partner who never misses a session.

Key to Health is designed for high-achieving, busy people who want to look better, feel better, and optimize their long-term health without spending hours on complex routines.

Backed by science. Guided by AI. Built for real life.

Our breath sensor gives you real-time feedback on your body's fat metabolism—so you can see what your daily choices are actually doing, not just hope for the best. Pair that with smart AI coaching, and you have a system that adapts to you.

What you'll get:
• Real-time fat metabolism tracking with our breath acetone sensor
• Personalized coaching from Key, your AI health guide
• Clear, science-based goals and progress tracking
• Tools to build strength and support long-term health
• Eat what you love—no restricted foods, no keto required

Meet Key: Your 24/7 AI Coach
Key learns from your habits, adjusts your plan, and guides you every step of the way. Instant support and personalized guidance, whenever you need it.

Grounded in clinical evidence. In a published clinical trial, participants following the Key to Health program lost an average of 10% total body weight over 48 weeks.

No fad diets. No extreme routines. No forbidden foods. Just real progress, made easy.

This app and breath monitor are for adults 18 years and older.

Subscription pricing and terms:
Key to Health offers an auto-renewing monthly subscription at $49.99/month to provide you with unlimited access to the Key to Health Premium collection while you maintain an active subscription.

Payment will be charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the current subscription price. You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to Settings > Manage Subscription on your device after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.

Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Terms of service: https://keytohealth.ai/terms
Privacy policy: https://keytohealth.ai/privacy
